zh-CN.title: 发表与聊天记录预览更顺手
items: 发表发言时可以顺畅滚动查看全部设置，深色模式下的输入区与开关排版也更加统一
广场中的合并聊天记录现在支持独立滚动，并可直接打开其中的位置卡片

en.title: Smoother posting and chat record previews
items: The post composer now scrolls through every setting cleanly, with a calmer dark-mode editor and aligned switches
Merged chat records in Square now scroll independently and open shared location cards directly
